lines.text: Believers were circumcised in Christ, with the circumcision performed by Moses and not by human hands.

problems.problem: Its true detail "putting off of their sinful nature" isn't in Colossians 2:11 word for word.
Its wrong detail "putting off of their idols" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
